title: Optimal Consumption and Retirement Time under Shortfall Risk Measure
summary: This paper studies the optimal portfolio, consumption, and endogenous early retirement problem within a benchmark tracking framework by incorporating a new relative performance evaluation. In this framework, the investor maximizes expected lifetime consumption utility while managing the maximum wealth shortfall relative to a benchmark, with shortfall-management costs that may differ before and after retirement.
